rationale: Colin's deep experience building developer communities and advocating for AI infrastructure aligns well with Abdul's focus on ML research and LLM tooling—Colin can offer mentorship on ecosystem strategy while Abdul brings fresh research perspectives on the inference and model optimization challenges Colin sees firsthand at Nebius. intro_message: Colin Nebius, meet Abdul Basith — Abdul's doing ML research at Northeastern with a focus on LLM tooling and CUDA, and Colin's been building the developer community and infrastructure layer for exactly that kind of work at Nebius.
